strings.main.n1.text: Oh, hello! I found a strange key outside my shop. Do you recognize it?”
strings.Mira.name: Mira
strings.main.n3.text: Careful! It feels warm, doesn’t it?
strings.You.name: You
strings.main.n4.text: Perhaps. What will you give me in return?
strings.main.n5.text: Near the old forest. I heard strange noises coming from there.
strings.main.n6.text: Wait! You might need that key someday…
